target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA: complete inventory of every Level A and AA success criterion
conformancePolicy: Level AA requires all Level A and Level AA success criteria; NOT_APPLICABLE is an implementation-scope classification with an individual justification and reclassification trigger, not an exclusion from WCAG conformance.

criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.risk: meaning is unavailable to screen-reader users
criteria.oracle: every informative non-text item has an equivalent accessible name/description; decorative items are hidden
criteria.testMethod: axe/Playwright accessibility tree plus manual chart alternative review

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.risk: an untracked feature could invalidate the documented non-applicability decision
criteria.oracle: the excluded content or interaction is absent from every release scope item
criteria.testMethod: manual scope and feature inventory review before release
criteria.notApplicableJustification: The MVP contains no prerecorded audio-only or video-only media.
criteria.reclassificationTrigger: any feature introducing content or interaction covered by this success criterion
